sectors.trend: Strong exploration momentum in WA: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica rare earths, Augustus gold (30g/t target), Auric Burbanks plant acceleration. Gold grades at Aguia (Colombia) also record. AUD weakness supports commodity exporters.
sectors.implications: Positive for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on commodity price support; small-cap explorers (Critica, Augustus, Auric) see catalyst-driven upside. Rare earths theme gains policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced on easing bond yields and rate-cut expectations. However, IMF fiscal warning and soaring state interest costs pressure credit growth. Private credit sector flagged as risk. Bathla insolvency contagion a concern.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from lower funding costs but face NIM compression risk. Monitor credit quality in private credit and construction lending.

sectors.trend: Middle East oil shock risk elevated; east-coast fuel supply crunch. Coal-power debate intensifies around $32bn Qld data centre. Green hydrogen spending questioned. Anthropic $31bn data centre deal drives power demand.
sectors.implications: Positive for energy producers (WDS.AX, SXG.AX) on supply tightness. Coal vs renewables policy uncertainty creates volatility. Data centre power demand supports long-term energy capex.

sectors.trend: Coles maintains higher milk prices post-farmer support removal; real wages growth crushed by exploited workers. Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse. Backpacker cuts hit tourism and farming supply.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer discretionary (Cue, Veronika Maine) in distress. Tourism-linked names (QNT.AX, LYC.AX) face labour supply risk.

sectors.trend: Tenant relief signals improving occupancy and rent dynamics. ACCC moves against real estate agency monopoly. Trump policy risk to Aussie house prices flagged. Housing affordability remains a political flashpoint.
sectors.implications: GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX benefit from tenant stability. Agency fee reform could boost net yields. Monitor Trump policy spillover on Australian property sentiment.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn Qld data centre deal; AI adoption in media (News Corp); AI job displacement narrative evolving. Oracle $7.5bn buyback signals US tech confidence.
sectors.implications: Supports Australian infrastructure and power demand. Local tech names limited but data centre capex benefits construction and energy sectors.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate higher near-term on bank strength and easing yields, but Fed uncertainty and AUD weakness cap upside. Oil volatility from Middle East is the key swing factor. Expect 1-2% range-bound trading in ^AXJO over next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining exploration, data centre capex, and energy transition support 6-12 month upside. However, IMF fiscal warning, persistent consumer inflation, and private credit risks create headwinds. RBA rate path is the critical variable. Moderate positive bias with 3-5% upside potential to ^AXJO over 12 months.
